ackList.detail: The plan Claim's conjunction: the real `fleet/run-main.mjs` driver invoking the real `skills/ultrapowers/scripts/ultra_run.py --validate-knobs … --no-baseline` on a live fleet run, so a green run pays the committed suite exactly twice (the integrated pass and the frozen gate's) and the ~5.5 min preflight suite pass is gone. — The Node sim `fleet/tests/test_run_main.mjs` stubs `ultra_run.py` entirely (it answers any `--validate-knobs` argv from the stub, lines 316-319), so it establishes only that the driver asks for the flag; Task 1's pytest exams invoke the script directly and establish only what the flag does inside the script. No committed test — and no command in the run evidence — exercises the two halves together against a real driver process, and the wall-clock saving is observable only on the next live run. The plan states this explicitly ("the live run is their conjunction"). [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]
